title: Snow Speed vs Fall Rate
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=snow:run
| stats avg(max_speed_kph) as avg_speed, avg(falls) as avg_falls, count as runs by slope_type
| sort - avg_speed
description: Compares whether more speed is simply translating into more falls on certain terrain.
value: This keeps progression honest by showing where chasing speed may be outrunning control.
implementation: Track run summaries with max speed, falls, and slope type in `index=personal`; compare safety trade-offs by terrain.
visualization: Slope-type table of average speed and average falls.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces whether going faster on the mountain is starting to come with a bigger falling cost than you want.
